title: Google\Cloud\Compute\V1\NetworkEndpointGroupAppEngine
name: NetworkEndpointGroupAppEngine
description: Configuration for an App Engine network endpoint group (NEG). The service is optional, may be provided explicitly or in the URL mask. The version is optional and can only be provided explicitly or in the URL mask when service is present.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.service
params.description: Optional serving service. The service name is case-sensitive and must be 1-63 characters long. Example value: "default", "my-service".

params.name: data.url_mask
params.description: A template to parse service and version fields from a request URL. URL mask allows for routing to multiple App Engine services without having to create multiple Network Endpoint Groups and backend services. For example, the request URLs "foo1-dot-appname.appspot.com/v1" and "foo1-dot-appname.appspot.com/v2" can be backed by the same Serverless NEG with URL mask "-dot-appname.appspot.com/". The URL mask will parse them to { service = "foo1", version = "v1" } and { service = "foo1", version = "v2" } respectively.

params.name: data.version
params.description: Optional serving version. The version name is case-sensitive and must be 1-100 characters long. Example value: "v1", "v2".

methods.name: getUrlMask
methods.description: A template to parse service and version fields from a request URL. URL mask allows for routing to multiple App Engine services without having to create multiple Network Endpoint Groups and backend services.

methods.name: setUrlMask
methods.description: A template to parse service and version fields from a request URL. URL mask allows for routing to multiple App Engine services without having to create multiple Network Endpoint Groups and backend services.
